label: Makeup
description: Named makeup looks, from everyday finishes and eye techniques to period, stage and special effects makeup.
notes: Applied cosmetic looks and recognizable techniques belong here, with brief names that fit after with. Natural facial structure belongs in person.face, and tattoos, piercings and henna belong in person.body_art. Period and costume looks remain available in contemporary scenes because they can be recreated with makeup; pigments do not imply descent or natural complexion. Existing adult_only markers are retained on corresponding looks, while permanent body changes and truly luminous fantasy effects are outside this list.

values.look: Sheer coverage, softly groomed brows and barely tinted lips leave skin texture visible.
A softly luminous base reflects light on the cheeks and forehead without a heavy powder finish.
An even, velvety base suppresses shine across the forehead, nose and cheeks.
An exceptionally smooth, glossy complexion catches bright, almost wet highlights across the face.
Light peach blush and matching sheer lips accompany softly shaded warm eyelids.
Pink cheeks and softly tinted rose lips create a gentle flush against lightly finished skin.
Warm bronze shading defines the cheekbones and temples, with coppery eyes and neutral lips.
Small irregular painted freckles scatter across the nose and cheeks over a sheer base.
Blended brown shadow lightly defines the lids and outer corners, with understated lips.
A clean dark line follows the upper lashes and extends into a pointed upward flick.
Crisp red lipstick stands out against restrained eyes and an even complexion.
Dark shadow surrounds the eyes and fades outward into a soft haze, paired with understated lips.
Blended neutral shadow, feathery lashes, softly sculpted cheeks and a satin lip have no hard edges.
A sharp curved boundary separates a pale eyelid from darker shadow above the crease.
Dark inner and outer eyelid corners frame a bright, reflective patch at the center of each lid.
Reflective gold covers the eyelids, with dark lashes and warm neutral lips.
Cool metallic silver eyelids stand out against dark lashes and softly finished skin.
Saturated emerald and violet shadows blend across the lids against otherwise restrained makeup.
Deep plum lipstick is the main focus, with softly defined eyes and muted cheeks.
Rich brown lipstick has a visibly wet shine, paired with warm neutral eyes.
Bright pink-orange lipstick contrasts with lightly defined eyes and fresh cheeks.
Black kohl rims the upper and lower lash lines, enclosing the eyes in a dense dark outline.
Muted mauve repeats across the eyelids, cheeks and lips, with soft blended edges.
Sharp geometric black lines extend beyond the lash line in angular shapes around the eyes.
A separate curved line sits above the eyelid crease, leaving bare skin between it and the lashes.
Bold outlined eye shapes surround deliberate gaps of bare skin instead of solid shadow.
Opaque white lines frame the eyes and stand out clearly against the lashes and skin.
Fluorescent-looking lime, orange or pink liner traces vivid lines around otherwise simple eyes.
Clear gloss makes the eyelids look wet and reflective over softly colored shadow.
Distinct glitter particles sparkle across the eyelids, rather than a smooth metallic sheen.
Small reflective gems are arranged along the lash lines and around the outer eye corners.
Flat saturated patches of contrasting colors form crisp shapes across and around the eyelids.
Sheer pink, blue and lavender washes blend into diffuse, translucent patches around the eyes.
Asymmetric blocks of pigment, painted brows and off-center lip shapes reshape the face graphically.
The upper and lower lips are painted in two sharply contrasting lipstick colors.
Powdered skin, dark rounded eyes and small dark lips emphasize an exaggerated cupid’s bow.
Thin arched brows, softly shaded lids and a sharply outlined rose lip define a powdered face.
Full arched brows and a defined red lip accompany modest liner and softly powdered skin.
Black cat-eye wings, strong arched brows and glossy red lips create a crisp, sculpted look.
Pale blue lids, a dark drawn crease and thick false lashes frame eyes with painted lower lashes.
Shimmering blue-purple shadow reaches toward the brows above glossy lips and luminous cheeks.
Strong pink blush sweeps diagonally from the cheeks to the temples beside vivid colored shadow.
Smudged dark liner and matte brown lips sit against a minimally polished complexion.
Icy pastel shimmer covers the lids and pale pink glossy lips, often with thin brows.
Pale foundation, heavily blackened eyes and black lipstick create a stark high-contrast face.
Pink blush crosses the nose and cheeks beneath heavy winged liner and small painted hearts.
Rough black eye shapes, sharply drawn brows and dark lipstick have deliberately jagged edges.
Thick swept eyeliner and red lips are joined by a painted beauty mark high on one cheek.
An opaque white base supports exaggerated brows, a red nose and an oversized painted mouth.
A white face, black outlined eyes and sharply drawn lips form a masklike expression.
Bold red and black strokes follow and exaggerate facial muscles over a white base.
Opaque white face powder, black and red eye accents and small red lips create crisp contrasts.
High drawn brows, enlarged cut creases, heavy lashes, strong contour and overlined lips reshape the face.
Strong brows, dark lash lines, pronounced cheek shading and defined lips remain visible from a distance.
Painted dark eye sockets, a skeletal nose and teeth are framed by colorful flowers and dotted ornaments.
Painted shadows and textured prosthetics add deep creases, under-eye bags and sagging facial folds.
Mottled purple, blue and yellow pigments imitate bruised skin around the cheek or eye.
Raised prosthetic edges and dark red pigment create the illusion of torn skin and a fresh cut.
Gray-green paint, sunken eye shadows and ragged prosthetic patches imitate decaying skin.
A smooth pale base is crossed by fine black fracture lines, with dark gaps suggesting broken ceramic.
